title: MEWP Use Permit
name: MEWP Use Permit
description: Controls planned use of mobile elevating work platforms, including operator competence, ground / route conditions, overhead hazards, segregation, rescue and machine checks.

sections.title: OPERATOR AND MACHINE READINESS
items: Machine inspection / examination status is current
Rated capacity and platform limits suit the task
Emergency lowering controls are known and accessible
Harness / restraint requirements are identified for the machine and task

sections.title: WORK AREA AND ACCESS CONTROLS
items: Ground, slab or supporting surface is suitable for the MEWP
Travel route and set-up area are clear and controlled
Overhead power lines, structures and crushing / trapping points are assessed
Pedestrians and vehicles are segregated from the operating area
Wind / weather / visibility conditions are suitable for the machine
Outriggers / stabilisers are used in accordance with manufacturer requirements where fitted

sections.title: RESCUE AND CLOSE-OUT
items: A practical rescue / emergency lowering plan is available
A person at ground level knows the emergency controls where required
The MEWP is parked, lowered, isolated and secured after use
Defects or incidents are reported and the machine is quarantined if necessary
